post.description: Reads one file (multipart field `file`: Markdown, text, HTML, Word .docx, PDF, CSV/TSV or Excel .xlsx) and answers with the note it holds — a title and blocks in the synced note format. Nothing is stored: the device creates the note itself. With `suggestSpace=true` (the person agreed to AI) the space or folder that fits best is picked from the account’s own, or `spaceId` is null. Blocks follow the `x-fluxo-blocks-version` request header (the version of the app’s block set; the server reads which block types it holds from the shared block registry): a block that set does not hold arrives as its fallback — a table as bullet lists, a web link as a linked line. An app without the header gets what the first release could show. Errors carry a `code`: file_required (400), file_too_large (413), unsupported_type / legacy_format (415), unreadable / protected / no_text / too_many_pages / too_long (422).
